title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Containers and Gross Weight at the Review Decision
content:
## Clause

At the decision on a Dangerous Goods Acceptance review, the quantities on the acceptance record, as they then stand, must lie within the category's ceilings on all three counts at once:

- the number of containers is not above the category's ceiling for one acceptance;
- the declared gross weight is not above the category's weight ceiling for one acceptance;
- the declared gross weight, shared out equally over the containers, is not above the category's ceiling for one container.

Reaching a ceiling exactly is within it.

## Worked check (invented ceilings)

Ceilings assumed for illustration: 6 containers, 90000 kg per acceptance, 17000 kg per container.

| Containers | Declared gross weight (kg) | Weight per container (kg) | Within all three? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | 85000 | 17000 | yes |
| 5 | 86000 | 17200 | no, per-container ceiling exceeded |
| 6 | 91000 | about 15167 | no, acceptance weight ceiling exceeded |
| 7 | 70000 | 10000 | no, container ceiling exceeded |

## Point of judgement

**A signed amendment raised the gross weight during review.** The raised figure is the one measured at the decision.
